## Implementation review: APPROVED

Artifact: branch worktree-knots-4bfa-path-mutation @ 3dd6dfca2b8d (pushed).
Diff: 6 files, +59/-49.

Acceptance criteria, each traced to code:
1. No test mutates process-global PATH -- grep 'set_var("PATH"' under src/ returns nothing. The two call sites in tests_registry_ext.rs now use CommandLoomBundleBuilder::with_binary(&loom_path) with read_bundle_source_with_builder.
2. 20 consecutive cargo test --bin knots runs on an unchanged tree: 0 failures. Compare 2 failures in 13 runs measured at b693169e before the fix.
3. Loom behaviors still covered by assertion, not deletion -- both tests retain their original assertions (BundleFormat::Json, bundle content, loom failure and invalid-utf8 error paths); only the binary-resolution mechanism changed.
4. env_lock removed from installed_workflows/tests_helpers.rs, so a panic in one loom test can no longer poison a mutex and cascade into the other.
5. machine::tests::machine_id_reads_the_process_environment now reads (never mutates) KNOTS_MACHINE_ID and compares against resolve_machine_id with the same value injected; all 8 machine tests pass with KNOTS_MACHINE_ID=pinned-ci-id exported.

Production behavior unchanged: CommandLoomBundleBuilder::new() still resolves KNOTS_LOOM_BIN, else the bare 'loom' name for the OS to resolve through PATH at spawn time.

Gates: make sanity exit 0 -- fmt, clippy -D warnings, file-size check, 1291 tests, 95.40% coverage against a 95 threshold. Changeset present. Pre-push hook re-ran sanity green on push.
